description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM U-Bolts for Attaching the Rear Leaf Springs to the Axle Housing
Rear Leaf Springs Only
Does One Side
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – U-Bolts
Qty 4 – Washers
Qty 4 – Nuts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
